question: For each program category, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of courses offered by departments in that category, considering only categories with more than 3 courses, and only including degree-granting courses? Show the category title and the calculated standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and exclude the 'Political Science' department from the calculation. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH dept_course_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CATEGORY_TITLE,
        scd.DEPARTMENT,
        COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count
    FROM CIP c
    JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
    WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
    GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT
)
SELECT 
    CATEGORY_TITLE,
    STDDEV(course_count) AS stddev_course_count
FROM dept_course_counts
GROUP BY CATEGORY_TITLE
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH area_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC), hr_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments, fo.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.area_stddev, a.DLC_NAME, h.num_hr_org_units, h.num_hr_departments FROM area_stats AS a JOIN hr_stats AS h ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = h.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND a.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME AND a.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY h.num_hr_org_units DESC, a.area_stddev DESC

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH area_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.area_stddev DESC), hr_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS num_hr_org_units FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_ID IN (138, 250) AND LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.DLC_NAME ORDER BY num_hr_org_units DESC, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LIMIT 3) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, COUNT(DISTINCT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS num_hr_departments, fo.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS fo ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND icte.DLC_NAME = fo.DLC_NAME JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE LOWER(hou.DLC_NAME) = 'biology' GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_NAME, icte.num_hr_org_units, fo.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.num_hr_org_units DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT a.ORGANIZATION_NAME, a.area_stddev, a.DLC_NAME, h.num_hr_org_units, h.num_hr_departments FROM area_stats AS a JOIN hr_stats AS h ON a.ORGANIZATION_NAME = h.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND a.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME AND a.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY h.num_hr_org_units DESC, a.area_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0) ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), Subquery2 AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MAX(sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_single_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, NULL AS highest_single_subject_enrollment, s1.avg_total_units, s1.stddev_total_units, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.highest_single_subject_enrollment, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS stddev_total_units, 'TopEngineering' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason

AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.school_name, cte1.department_phone, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev DESC

DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, kc.SUBJECT_CODE, kc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM top_departments AS td JOIN kevin_courses AS kc ON td.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC = kc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC AND td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM
